材料可以是选中的文字、自己补充的文本、文件本体或图片。直接修改这次带上的文字，在: Materials can include selected text, additional text, files and images. Edit text directly, then type or paste additional material within the same panel. Edits are retained automatically and used for handoff. The original selection stays in this page for comparison and restoration; provenance remains. Files show their name and type, rather than passing off a path as an attachment. Images have thumbnails and full previews. Remove any item; references only join the handoff when explicitly added.
某个接收位置只支持文字时，图片和文件不能悄悄被丢掉。界面应指出不支持的材料，让人: When a destination supports only text, images and files must not disappear silently. Identify unsupported materials so the user can change destination or remove them. Choose or drop local files, or paste images in this page; the demo neither uploads them nor parses file contents.
有明确地址、后台投递和接收确认的连接，主动作是“发送”。浮层收起，人留在来源，想: For connections with an explicit address, background delivery and receipt confirmation, the primary action is Send. The panel closes while the source stays active; open the receiver when needed. Where only composer insertion is supported, the action says Continue in the app and explains that the app will open. Clipboard-only connections report only that text was copied; the user must still check the session and paste.
“存入 Pocket”保存独立的一批材料、指令和去处，不只是关掉浮层。新采集不会: Save to Pocket stores an independent batch of materials, instructions and destination. New captures do not inherit the previous instructions; restoring a batch does not send it. With current input present, the restore action says Save current and restore. Add materials only copies the selected batch into the current draft, preserving its instructions and destination and keeping the original batch in Pocket.
